Perfect! The implementation is complete. Let me create a summary of the work done.

## Report

### Summary

Successfully implemented product filtering to respect onboarding department selection. The changes ensure that when users complete onboarding and select "Women's Fashion" (or any department in the future), the main page automatically displays only products matching their selected department preference.

### Changes Made

**1. Updated `useOutfitDiscovery` Hook** (`frontend/lib/hooks/useOutfitDiscovery.ts`):
   - Imported `useUserProfile` hook to access user profile data
   - Modified filter initialization to pass user's gender preference to `parseFiltersFromUrl`
   - Updated `resetFilters` function to use `profile?.gender || 'all'` instead of hardcoded `'all'`
   - This ensures the user's department preference is respected both on initial load and when resetting filters

**2. Updated `parseFiltersFromUrl` Function** (`frontend/lib/utils/url-params.ts`):
   - Added optional `userGender` parameter to function signature
   - Implemented priority logic: URL params > user profile > default 'all'
   - Enhanced filter initialization to respect user preferences while allowing manual overrides via URL

### Implementation Details

The solution implements a three-tier priority system:
1. **URL parameters** (highest priority) - allows users to manually change filters
2. **User profile gender** (medium priority) - respects onboarding selection
3. **Default 'all'** (lowest priority) - fallback for users without profiles

### Validation

- ✅ TypeScript compilation succeeded without errors
- ✅ Build completed successfully (Next.js production build)
- ✅ No new linting errors introduced
- ✅ Filter initialization logic properly respects user profile
- ✅ Reset filters maintains user's department preference

### Expected Behavior After Changes

- Users completing onboarding with "Women's Fashion" will see only women's products on the main page
- The gender filter will be initialized to match the user's profile preference
- Clicking "Clear all filters" will reset to the user's profile preference, not to 'all'
- Manual filter changes via UI or URL parameters still work correctly
- Users without completed profiles will see all products (default behavior)
